fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOGL) reported Q3 revenue of $12.757 billion, missing consensus of $12.82 billion, causing the stock price to plummet 10% in pre-market trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: Search revenue of $6.34 billion (missing the expected $6.49 billion) and negative free cash flow of $9.1 billion raised investor concerns.
